## 🎨 Features of the New Loader

- **Two beautiful gradient variants**: Purple-to-teal and Red-to-green gradients
- **Smooth animation**: 1.75s ease-out infinite dash animation
- **Responsive sizing**: Small (sm), medium (md), and large (lg) sizes
- **Consistent styling**: Matches your project's design system
- **Performance optimized**: Uses CSS animations instead of JavaScript

## 🚀 Usage

You can now use the new loader anywhere in your project:

```tsx
import { AnimatedLoader } from '@/components/ui/AnimatedLoader';

// Basic usage
<AnimatedLoader />

// With size and variant
<AnimatedLoader size="lg" variant="gradient2" />

// With custom styling
<AnimatedLoader className="my-custom-class" />
```

The new animated loader provides a much more modern and visually appealing loading experience compared to the previous spinning circles and icons. The gradient colors and smooth animation create a professional, polished feel throughout your application.
